title: Sable and the Uniform
author: Felix Delacroix
blurb: Ansel Kavanagh, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the ice breaks on the river.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
